purpose: Define the public ASDFASDFA/Talaria/CYNIC futarchy manifest contract so product UI, public copy, build proofs, decisions and outcomes remain projections of a typed source instead of drifting into React constants or private notes.

must_not_own: autonomous public posting before human approval

guardrails: No guaranteed pump, floor, buyback or listing.
No claim that ASDFASDFA owns Talaria or CYNIC.
Market price is signal, not truth.
The interface must show work before asking for belief.
